title: Answer: the evolving quantum state and the mental events that probe it

statements.text: What is fundamental is the evolving objective quantum state of the universe, an informational structure, together with the sequence of mental events, each tied to an individual system, that pose questions to it and register the answers.

sources.quote: Von Neumann quantum theory is essentially a theory of the interaction between the evolving objective state of the physical universe and a sequence of mental events
